smellBench.action: import every upstream repo identity from rows; missing inventory blocks locking

discoveryExclusions.forkPolicy: GitHub parent/source network plus patch/token duplicate components

api.pagination: all pages; recursively bisect dates if search total_count >1000; unresolved truncation is incomplete
api.rateLimit: obey Retry-After; at most 3 retries; persist cursor then incomplete
api.archive: raw JSON, request URL, fetch time, response hash; no credentials in output

positiveRoutes: maintainer review suggestion whose old/new target bytes match accepted patch
maintainer-authored narrow PR with merged_at, eligible intent in title/body and <=3 changed production files, <=200 changed executable lines, one family after C1/N1 collision resolves to N1
labelExtraction.regexFlags: case-insensitive; apply to one sentence; never infer negation semantically
labelExtraction.neutral: explicit rename/move/formatting/documentation/test-only intent AND parse-token/body/graph invariance appropriate to claimed control; validation cannot depend on candidate output
labelExtraction.intentional: maintainer keep/retain/intentional sentence names target structure with source range; accepted child retains target; otherwise exclude
labelExtraction.mixedPurposeReject: explicit feature, behavior, API, bug or performance objective alongside structural intent; syntax PERF403 performance is permitted only in the rule-conformance lane
labelExtraction.reviewAcceptance: accepted suggestion exactly present in merged code; resolved-thread status alone insufficient
labelExtraction.correctness: merged PR links an issue and names a bug/fix, excludes all structural intent families; correctness evidence recorded as maintainer-accepted, not locally executed test success
labelExtraction.ambiguous: excluded-with-reason; never ask for a new quality label

snapshots.before: accepted review original_commit_id or first parent of one verified squash/merge-result commit
snapshots.after: accepted merged commit; verify target bytes
snapshots.mergeProtection: exclude unrelated base-branch drift; use review parent/child if recoverable; ambiguous merge topology excluded
snapshots.sourceClassification: native discovery defaults at frozen Trellis commit; exclude tests/generated/vendor from primary; retain all classifications; no per-result overrides
snapshots.deletionGuard: Record deleted/public owners and changed API tokens; deletion without mapped replacement or accepted explicit dead-code intent is not a structural positive; dead-code-only intent is outside these studies.

deduplication.near: Jaccard of normalized 5-token shingles >=0.80 on either target side or patch; all-pairs exact Jaccard for this bounded census
deduplication.normalization: erase comments/whitespace; alpha-normalize local identifiers by first binding occurrence; preserve literal kind and equality; hash normalizer implementation
deduplication.group: connected components including repository/fork/backport/PR/clone-family links; one split per component

split.order: SHA256(common.seed + NUL + panelId + NUL + language + NUL + repositoryKey), bytewise ascending
split.qualified: enough independently labeled matched blocks and controls for panel quotas before calculating predictors
split.development: first 4 eligible groups/language plus all known exploratory groups for mechanics only
split.reserve: next 8 eligible groups/language; unread labels/predictors beyond counts; insufficient reserve does not fabricate a confirmation
split.crossPanel: an already opened validation group is development-only for later revised designs; unchanged preregistered panels may share locked groups
split.failure: quota shortfall => incomplete; no selecting favorable repositories
split.sharedControlFlowPanel: C1/N1 use one control-flow panel assignment; groups must support both target quotas; PRs meeting both intent families enter N1 only, prior to measurement.

pinnedDevelopmentSources.labels: typed S110 and stable PERF403 snapshots in existing source record
valid/invalid literal test cases; no arbitrary fixture evaluation
only test-bound expected diagnostics; lineage-shared conformance, not independent validation

seal.resolveRevision: literal full commit/tree/blob hashes; never main in lock
seal.fixtureExtraction: static parse literal valid/invalid cases and options only; helper-generated cases with unevaluated expressions excluded with count
seal.license: record each upstream source notice; redistribute identifiers/hashes unless source terms allow copies; no scb-check rule redistribution
